name: When should I consider a second-story addition instead of moving?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider a second-story addition instead of moving?

acceptedAnswer.text: Consider a second-story addition if you love your current location, neighborhood, or school district but need more space. It's often a cost-effective alternative to the expenses and upheaval of selling, buying, and moving, especially in desirable areas. If your lot size is limited, preventing ground-level expansion, or if you wish to significantly increase property value while staying in your beloved home, a second story is an excellent solution.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider an addition if you need more space but want to stay in your current location, rather than incurring moving costs and hassle.
